premise: At 58, after 31 years as a public-school bus dispatcher, I discovered my daughter used my TreasuryDirect password and forged my signature to cash out $139,000 in near-maturity government bonds so she could buy a fleet of inflatable bouncy-house party units; I proved the signature was forged by a broker's handwriting analysis, voided the liquidation, seized the inflatables and delivery trailer, and now run 'Bounce of Deceit Party Rentals,' where she scrubs vinyl castles in a coverall that says 'Bounced My Retirement' and every rental agreement prints her fraud-docket number.
